name: errors
doc: Error values: wrapping, unwrapping, matching by value (Is) or type (As) and error traces.

items.name: As
items.doc: As finds the first error in err's chain whose type is T, stores it in *target and reports whether there was one.
items.summary: As finds the first error in err's chain whose type is T, stores it in *target and reports whether there was one.

examples.name: ExampleAs

items.name: Frames
items.doc: Frames returns the error trace of err as records, one per line of `Trace`.
items.summary: Frames returns the error trace of err as records, one per line of `Trace`.

items.name: Is
items.signature: func Is(err error, target error) bool
items.doc: Is reports whether err or any error it wraps is target.
items.summary: Is reports whether err or any error it wraps is target.

examples.name: ExampleIs

items.name: New
items.doc: New returns an error whose `Message()` is msg (the same as `error(msg)`).
items.summary: New returns an error whose `Message()` is msg (the same as `error(msg)`).

items.name: Trace
items.doc: Trace returns the return trace recorded while err propagated (empty with --no-error-trace).
items.summary: Trace returns the return trace recorded while err propagated (empty with --no-error-trace).

items.name: Unwrap
items.doc: Unwrap returns the error err wraps, or nil.
items.summary: Unwrap returns the error err wraps, or nil.

items.name: Wrap
items.signature: func Wrap(err error, msg string) error
items.doc: Wrap returns an error whose message is msg + ": " + err's and that unwraps to err.
items.summary: Wrap returns an error whose message is msg + ": " + err's and that unwraps to err.

examples.name: ExampleWrap

items.name: Frame
items.doc: Frame is one line of an error trace (`errors.Frames`).
items.summary: Frame is one line of an error trace (`errors.Frames`).

members.name: Context
members.doc: The text of `?("...")` at this frame, or "".
members.summary: The text of `?("...")` at this frame, or "".
